057        public static class PerShipData implements Cloneable {
058                public ShipCondition condition = ShipCondition.AVERAGE;
059                public String variantId = null;
060                public ShipVariantAPI variant = null;
061                public PersonAPI captain = null;
062                public String shipName = null;
063                public String fleetMemberId = null;
064                public boolean addDmods = true;
065                public boolean pruneWeapons = true;
066                public Boolean nameAlwaysKnown = null;
067                public float sModProb = 0f;
068                public PerShipData(String variantId, ShipCondition condition) {
069                        this(variantId, condition, 0f);
070                }
071                public PerShipData(String variantId, ShipCondition condition, float sModProb) {
072                        this(variantId, condition, Factions.INDEPENDENT, sModProb);
073                }
074                public PerShipData(ShipVariantAPI variant, ShipCondition condition, String shipName, String factionIdForShipName, float sModProb) {
075                        this.variant = variant;
076                        this.condition = condition;
077                        
078                        if (shipName != null) {
079                                this.shipName = shipName;
080                        } else {
081                                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionIdForShipName);
082                                this.shipName = faction.pickRandomShipName();
083                        }
084                        
085                        this.sModProb = sModProb;
086                }
087                
088                public PerShipData(String variantId, ShipCondition condition, String factionIdForShipName, float sModProb) {
089                        this.variantId = variantId;
090                        this.condition = condition;
091                        
092                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionIdForShipName);
093                        this.shipName = faction.pickRandomShipName();
094                        
095                        this.sModProb = sModProb;
096                }
097                
098                public ShipVariantAPI getVariant() {
099                        ShipVariantAPI result = variant;
100                        if (result == null && variantId != null) {
101                                result = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId);
102                        }
103                        return result;
104                }
105                
106                @Override
107                public PerShipData clone() {
108                        try { return (PerShipData) super.clone(); } catch (CloneNotSupportedException e) { return null; }
109                }
110                
111        }

145        public static ShipRecoverySpecialData getSpecialData(SectorEntityToken entity, String desc, boolean create, boolean replace) {
146                Object o = Misc.getSalvageSpecial(entity);
147                ShipRecoverySpecialData data = null;
148                if (o instanceof ShipRecoverySpecialData) {
149                        data = (ShipRecoverySpecialData) o;
150                }
151                
152                if (data == null && !create) return null;
153                if (o != null && data == null && !replace) return null;
154                
155                if (data == null) {
156                        data = new ShipRecoverySpecialData(desc);
157                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(entity, data);
158                }
159                
160                return data;
161        }

341        protected FleetMemberAPI first = null;
342        protected void addMember(PerShipData shipData) {
343                if (shipData.variant == null && shipData.variantId == null) {
344                        return;
345                }
346                
347                FleetMemberAPI member = null;
348                if (shipData.variantId != null) {
349                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, shipData.variantId);
350                } else {
351                        member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, shipData.variant);
352                }
353                
354                //if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.UNBOARDABLE)) {
355                if (Misc.isUnboardable(member)) {
356                        return;
357                }
358                
359                members.add(member);
360                
361                if (first == null) first = member;
362                
363                member.setOwner(1);
364                if (shipData.fleetMemberId != null) {
365                        member.setId(shipData.fleetMemberId);
366                }
367                
368                if (shipData.captain != null) {
369                        member.setCaptain(shipData.captain);
370                }
371                
372                if (isNameKnown(shipData.condition) || (shipData.nameAlwaysKnown != null && shipData.nameAlwaysKnown)) {
373                        member.setShipName(shipData.shipName);
374                } else {
375                        member.setShipName("<name unknown>");
376                }
377                
378                prepareMember(member, shipData);
379        }
380        
381        public static boolean isNameKnown(ShipCondition condition) {
382                return condition == ShipCondition.PRISTINE || condition == ShipCondition.GOOD;
383        }
384        
385        public void prepareMember(FleetMemberAPI member, PerShipData shipData) {
386                
387                int hits = getHitsForCondition(member, shipData.condition);
388                int dmods = getDmodsForCondition(shipData.condition);
389                
390                int reduction = (int) playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.SHIP_DMOD_REDUCTION, 0);
391                reduction = random.nextInt(Math.abs(reduction) + 1) * (int)Math.signum(reduction);
392                dmods -= reduction;
393                
394                
395                member.getStatus().setRandom(random);
396                
397                for (int i = 0; i < hits; i++) {
398                        member.getStatus().applyDamage(1000000f);
399                }
400
401                member.getStatus().setHullFraction(getHullForCondition(shipData.condition));
402                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(0f);
403                
404                
405                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
406                variant = variant.clone();
407                variant.setOriginalVariant(null);
408                
409                int dModsAlready = DModManager.getNumDMods(variant);
410                dmods = Math.max(0, dmods - dModsAlready);
411                
412                if (dmods > 0 && shipData.addDmods) {
413                        DModManager.setDHull(variant);
414                }
415                member.setVariant(variant, false, true);
416                
417                if (dmods > 0 && shipData.addDmods) {
418                        DModManager.addDMods(member, true, dmods, random);
419                }
420                
421                if (shipData.sModProb > 0 && random.nextFloat() < shipData.sModProb) {
422                        int num = 1;
423                        float r = random.nextFloat();
424                        if (r > 0.85f) {
425                                num = 3;
426                        } else if (r > 0.5f) {
427                                num = 2;
428                        }
429                        
430                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
431                        for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
432                                HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
433                                if (spec.isHidden()) continue;
434                                if (spec.isHiddenEverywhere()) continue;
435                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) continue;
436                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NO_BUILD_IN)) continue;
437                                if (variant.getPermaMods().contains(spec.getId())) continue;
438                                picker.add(id, spec.getCapitalCost());
439                        }
440                        for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
441                                String id = picker.pickAndRemove();
442                                variant.addPermaMod(id, true);
443                                //variant.getPermaMods().add(id);
444                        }
445                }
446                
447                
448                if (shipData.pruneWeapons) {
449                        float retain = getFighterWeaponRetainProb(shipData.condition);
450                        FleetEncounterContext.prepareShipForRecovery(member, false, false, false, retain, retain, random);
451                        member.getVariant().autoGenerateWeaponGroups();
452                }
453        }

455
456        protected float getHullForCondition(ShipCondition condition) {
457                switch (condition) {
458                case PRISTINE: return 1f;
459                case GOOD: return 0.6f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
460                case AVERAGE: return 0.4f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
461                case BATTERED: return 0.2f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f;
462                case WRECKED: return random.nextFloat() * 0.1f;
463                }
464                return 1;
465        }
466        
467        
468        protected int getDmodsForCondition(ShipCondition condition) {
469                if (condition == ShipCondition.PRISTINE) return 0;
470                
471                boolean reduceQuality = Misc.isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("ext_reduceDerelictQuality");
472                if (reduceQuality) {
473                        switch (condition) {
474                        case GOOD: return 1 + random.nextInt(1);
475                        case AVERAGE: return 2 + random.nextInt(2);
476                        case BATTERED: return 3 + random.nextInt(3);
477                        case WRECKED: return 4 + random.nextInt(2);
478                        }
479                }
480                
481                switch (condition) {
482                case GOOD: return 1;
483                case AVERAGE: return 1 + random.nextInt(2);
484                case BATTERED: return 2 + random.nextInt(2);
485                case WRECKED: return 3 + random.nextInt(2);
486                }
487                return 1;
488        }
489        
490        protected float getFighterWeaponRetainProb(ShipCondition condition) {
491                switch (condition) {
492                case PRISTINE: return 1f;
493                case GOOD: return 0.67f;
494                case AVERAGE: return 0.5f;
495                case BATTERED: return 0.33f;
496                case WRECKED: return 0.2f;
497                }
498                return 0f;
499        }
500        
501        protected int getHitsForCondition(FleetMemberAPI member, ShipCondition condition) {
502                if (condition == ShipCondition.PRISTINE) return 0;
503                if (condition == ShipCondition.WRECKED) return 20;
504                
505                switch (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
506                case CAPITAL_SHIP:
507                        switch (condition) {
508                        case GOOD: return 2 + random.nextInt(2);
509                        case AVERAGE: return 4 + random.nextInt(3);
510                        case BATTERED: return 7 + random.nextInt(6);
511                        }
512                        break;
513                case CRUISER:
514                        switch (condition) {
515                        case GOOD: return 1 + random.nextInt(2);
516                        case AVERAGE: return 2 + random.nextInt(3);
517                        case BATTERED: return 4 + random.nextInt(4);
518                        }
519                        break;
520                case DESTROYER:
521                        switch (condition) {
522                        case GOOD: return 1 + random.nextInt(2);
523                        case AVERAGE: return 2 + random.nextInt(2);
524                        case BATTERED: return 3 + random.nextInt(3);
525                        }
526                        break;
527                case FRIGATE:
528                        switch (condition) {
529                        case GOOD: return 1;
530                        case AVERAGE: return 2;
531                        case BATTERED: return 3;
532                        }
533                        break;
534                }
535                return 1;
536        }

583                        }

589                                storyPool = members;

591                        
592                        dialog.showFleetMemberRecoveryDialog("Select ships to recover", pool, storyPool,
593                                        new FleetMemberPickerListener() {
594                                public void pickedFleetMembers(List<FleetMemberAPI> selected) {
595                                        if (selected.isEmpty()) return;
596                                        
597                                        new ShowDefaultVisual().execute(null, dialog, Misc.tokenize(""), memoryMap);
598                                        
599                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : selected) {
600                                                int index = members.indexOf(member);
601                                                if (index >= 0) {
602                                                        PerShipData shipData = data.ships.get(index);
603                                                        data.ships.remove(index);
604                                                        members.remove(index);
605                                                        
606                                                        
607                                                        member.setShipName(shipData.shipName);
608                                                        if (shipData.fleetMemberId != null) {
609                                                                member.setId(shipData.fleetMemberId);
610                                                        }
611                                                        
612                                                        float minHull = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MIN, 0f);
613                                                        float maxHull = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_HULL_MAX, 0f);
614                                                        float minCR = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MIN, 0f);
615                                                        float maxCR = playerFleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.RECOVERED_CR_MAX, 0f);
616                                                        
617                                                        float hull = (float) Math.random() * (maxHull - minHull) + minHull;
618                                                        hull = Math.max(hull, member.getStatus().getHullFraction());
619                                                        if (hull > 1f) hull = 1f;
620                                                        member.getStatus().setHullFraction(hull);
621                                                        
622                                                        float cr = (float) Math.random() * (maxCR - minCR) + minCR;
623                                                        if (cr > 0.7f) cr = 0.7f;
624                                                        member.getRepairTracker().setCR(cr);
625                                                        
626                                                        playerFleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
627                                                        recovered.add(member);
628                                                }
629                                        }
630                                        
631//                                      setExtraSalvageFromUnrecoveredShips();
632//                                      setDone(true);
633//                                      setShowAgain(!data.ships.isEmpty());
634                                        if (dialog.getPlugin() instanceof SalvageSpecialDialogPlugin) {
635                                                SalvageSpecialDialogPlugin plugin = (SalvageSpecialDialogPlugin) dialog.getPlugin();
636                                                plugin.optionSelected(null, RECOVERY_FINISHED);
637                                        } else {
638                                                // bad state, exit dialog
639                                                // apparently possible? maybe mods involved

641                                                dialog.dismiss();
642                                        }
643                                }

646                        });
647                        
648                } else if (NOT_NOW.equals(optionData)) {
649                        if (data.notNowOptionExits != null && data.notNowOptionExits) {
650//                              setDone(true);
651//                              setShowAgain(true);
652//                              setEndWithContinue(false);
653                                dialog.dismiss();
654                        } else {
655                                if (isStoryPointRecovery()) {
656                                        //Misc.setSalvageSpecial(entity, null);
657                                        Misc.setSalvageSpecial(entity, Misc.getPrevSalvageSpecial(entity));
658                                }

660                                new ShowDefaultVisual().execute(null, dialog, Misc.tokenize(""), memoryMap);
661                                
662                                // only get extra salvage when it's not story-point recovery
663                                // since unless the story point is spent and the ship is recovered
664                                // it's not in a "recoverable" state an should grant no bonus stuff when salvaged
665                                if (!isStoryPointRecovery()) {
666                                        addExtraSalvageFromUnrecoveredShips();
667                                }
668                                setDone(true);
669                                setEndWithContinue(false);
670                                setShowAgain(true);
671                        }
672                } else if (RECOVERY_FINISHED.equals(optionData)) {
673                        new ShowDefaultVisual().execute(null, dialog, Misc.tokenize(""), memoryMap);
674                        
675                        boolean wreck = Entities.WRECK.equals(entity.getCustomEntityType());
676                        wreck |= entity.hasTag(Tags.WRECK);
677                        
678                        if (wreck) {
679                                //ExtraSalvage es = BaseSalvageSpecial.getExtraSalvage(entity);
680                                //if (es != null && !es.cargo.isEmpty()) {
681                                CargoAPI extra = BaseSalvageSpecial.getCombinedExtraSalvage(entity);
682                                if (extra != null && !extra.isEmpty()) {
683                                        addText("Your crews find some securely stowed cargo during the recovery operation.");
684                                        
685                                        extra.sort();
686                                        playerFleet.getCargo().addAll(extra);
687                                        
688                                        
689                                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : extra.getStacksCopy()) {
690                                                AddRemoveCommodity.addStackGainText(stack, text);
691                                        }
692                                        clearExtraSalvage(entity);
693                                        
694                                        ListenerUtil.reportSpecialCargoGainedFromRecoveredDerelict(extra, dialog);
695                                        //addText("The recovery operation is finished without any further surprises.");
696                                }
697                                
698                                addText("The " + first.getShipName() + " is now part of your fleet.");
699                                
700                                setShouldAbortSalvageAndRemoveEntity(true);
701                                options.clearOptions();
702                                options.addOption("Leave", ABORT_CONTINUE);
703                                options.setShortcut(ABORT_CONTINUE, Keyboard.KEY_ESCAPE, false, false, false, true);
704                                
705                                ListenerUtil.reportShipsRecovered(recovered, dialog);
706

708                                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$srs_memberId", member.getId(), 0);
709                                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$srs_hullId", member.getHullId(), 0);
710                                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$srs_baseHullId", member.getHullSpec().getBaseHullId(), 0);
711                                        FireAll.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "PostShipRecoverySpecial");
712                                }

714                        } else {

717                                setDone(true);
718                                setShowAgain(!data.ships.isEmpty());
719                                
720//                              setExtraSalvageFromUnrecoveredShips();
721//                              setDone(true);
722//                              setEndWithContinue(false);
723//                              setShowAgain(true);
724                        }
725                } else if (ABORT_CONTINUE.equals(optionData)) {
726                        setDone(true);
727                        setEndWithContinue(false);
728                }
729        }

731        protected void addExtraSalvageFromUnrecoveredShips() {
732                if (members.isEmpty()) return;
733                
734                CargoAPI extra = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
735                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
736                        addStuffFromMember(extra, member);
737                }
738                addTempExtraSalvage(extra);
739        }
740        
741        protected void addStuffFromMember(CargoAPI cargo, FleetMemberAPI member) {
742                cargo.addCommodity(Commodities.SUPPLIES, member.getRepairTracker().getSuppliesFromScuttling());
743                cargo.addCommodity(Commodities.FUEL, member.getRepairTracker().getFuelFromScuttling());
744                cargo.addCommodity(Commodities.HEAVY_MACHINERY, member.getRepairTracker().getHeavyMachineryFromScuttling());
745                
746                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
747                for (String slotId : variant.getNonBuiltInWeaponSlots()) {
748                        cargo.addWeapons(variant.getWeaponId(slotId), 1);
749                }
750                
751                int index = 0;
752                for (String wingId : variant.getWings()) {
753                        if (wingId != null && !wingId.isEmpty() && !variant.getHullSpec().isBuiltInWing(index)) {
754                                cargo.addFighters(wingId, 1);
755                        }
756                        index++;
757                }
758        }
